WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    p.product_color AS color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE ili.order_item_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
),
ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY color ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_data
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY color, rank, order_item_id
